title: Modul POS - Payment Processing - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap memproses pembayaran di POS mencakup berbagai metode pembayaran, multi-payment, tax calculation, receipt, dan refund handling.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: Payment Processing adalah tahap final dalam order untuk mengumpulkan uang dari customer. POS support berbagai payment methods (cash, card, QRIS, dll) dengan kemampuan multi-payment, automatic tax calculation, dan receipt generation.

items.title: 1. CASH (Tunai)
items.body:
Metode pembayaran paling sederhana & cepat.

**Proses:**
1. Order total: Rp 63.000
2. Click 'Pay' → Payment dialog
3. Select 'Cash' method
4. Input nominal uang dari customer: Rp 100.000
5. System auto-hitung kembalian:
   - Change = Rp 100.000 - Rp 63.000 = Rp 37.000
6. Display:
   - Amount due: Rp 63.000
   - Amount received: Rp 100.000
   - Change: Rp 37.000
7. Review & confirm
8. Click 'Accept Payment'
9. Payment status: PAID

**Validasi:**
- Amount received harus >= total order
- Jika < total: Warning "Insufficient payment"
- Accept only after amount enough

**Pembayaran Pas (exact):**
- Customer give: Rp 63.000
- Change: Rp 0
- System allow

**Overpayment (kelebihan):**
- Customer give: Rp 100.000 untuk order Rp 63.000
- Change: Rp 37.000
- Cashier berikan kembalian
- Overage amount recorded (untuk variance reconciliation nanti)

items.title: 2. DEBIT/CREDIT CARD
items.body:
Pembayaran via kartu debit atau kredit menggunakan EDC (Electronic Data Capture) machine.

**Prerequisites:**
- EDC machine terhubung ke device
- EDC initialized & tested
- Payment gateway active

**Proses:**
1. Click 'Pay' → Payment dialog
2. Select 'Debit/Credit Card'
3. Amount to charge: Rp 63.000 (auto-filled)
4. Prompt: "Please tap/swipe card"
5. Customer tap/swipe kartu di EDC
6. EDC process transaksi
7. Possible results:
   a. APPROVED: Transaksi success
      - Display: "Approved"
      - Receipt dari EDC printed
      - Payment status: PAID
   b. DECLINED: Kartu ditolak
      - Display: "Card declined"
      - Reason: Insufficient funds, invalid card, etc
      - Cashier ask: Retry atau switch method?
   c. TIMEOUT: EDC tidak respond
      - Timeout default: 60 second
      - Ask customer: Try again atau gunakan method lain?

**PIN/Signature:**
- EDC may require PIN entry (untuk kartu debit)
- Or signature (untuk kartu kredit)
- Process otomatis di EDC (POS tidak perlu handle)

**Error Handling:**
- If EDC offline: Switch to cash atau QRIS
- If declined: Retry atau alternative method
- If timeout: Retry atau alternative

**Receipt:**
- EDC print merchant copy & customer copy
- POS also print receipt (dengan payment method detail)

items.title: 3. QRIS (Indonesian Digital Payment)
items.body:
Pembayaran via QR code yang di-scan customer menggunakan mobile banking/e-wallet.

**Supported Apps:**
- Dana, OVO, GoPay, LinkAja, GCash, DANA, Alipay, WeChat Pay, dll

**Proses:**
1. Click 'Pay' → Payment dialog
2. Select 'QRIS'
3. Amount: Rp 63.000 (auto-filled)
4. System generate QR code (dari payment provider)
5. Display QR code di screen/tablet
6. Customer scan dengan app mobile banking
7. Customer confirm di app mereka
8. Konfirmasi terima di payment provider (bank/fintech)
9. System get notification → Payment successful
10. Display: "Payment received"
11. Payment status: PAID
12. Receipt printed

**Timeout:**
- Default: 5 menit untuk customer scan & pay
- If timeout: Ask customer payment sudah masuk atau retry

**Error Handling:**
- QRIS invalid: Regenerate & ask customer retry
- Network error: Retry atau switch method
- Payment not confirmed: Wait 30 sec atau ask customer check app

**Advantages:**
- Fast & safe (no cash handling)
- Customer prefer untuk digital payment
- Auto reconciliation dengan bank
- Digital receipt (bisa email/SMS ke customer)

items.title: 4. MULTI-PAYMENT (Kombinasi)
items.body:
Customer pembayaran dengan 2+ metode untuk satu order.

**Use Cases:**
- Cash Rp 100.000 + QRIS Rp 50.000 = Total Rp 150.000
- Loyalty points + Cash combination
- Corporate account + personal payment

**Proses:**
1. Order total: Rp 150.000
2. Click 'Pay' → Payment dialog
3. Select method pertama: 'Cash'
4. Input amount: Rp 100.000
5. Confirm cash payment
6. Remaining: Rp 50.000 (auto-calculate)
7. Display: "Remaining balance: Rp 50.000"
8. Ask: "Continue dengan method lain?"
9. Click 'Add Payment Method'
10. Select method kedua: 'QRIS'
11. Amount: Rp 50.000 (pre-filled)
12. Generate QR code
13. Customer scan & pay
14. Confirm di app
15. System verify
16. Payment status: PAID (semua metode terpenuhi)
17. Receipt show: Semua metode yg digunakan

**Validasi:**
- Total pembayaran harus = order total (tidak boleh lebih/kurang)
- Max 3 metode per order (configurable)
- Jika melebihi: Error "Max payment methods reached"

**Receipt Multi-Payment:**
- Breakdown semua metode:
  * Cash: Rp 100.000
  * QRIS: Rp 50.000
  * Total: Rp 150.000

**Refund untuk Multi-Payment:**
- Jika ada return: Refund proportional ke setiap metode
- Atau customer choose: Refund ke method tertentu

items.title: 5. CEK (Corporate/B2B)
items.body:
Pembayaran via cek untuk transaksi B2B atau corporate orders.

**Proses:**
1. Click 'Pay' → Payment dialog
2. Select 'Check'
3. Input fields:
   - Check number*: Nomor cek
   - Bank name*: Bank penerbit
   - Check date*: Tanggal cek (tanggal jatuh tempo)
   - Amount: Auto-filled (order total)
4. Review & confirm
5. Payment status: PAID (tapi reconciliation beda)
6. Cek disimpan untuk clearing ke bank

**Validasi:**
- Check number tidak boleh duplicate (dalam periode tertentu)
- Bank name harus valid
- Check date minimal hari ini (post-dated check)

**Processing:**
- Cek tidak langsung clear
- Finance team clearing sesuai check date
- Reconciliation dengan bank
- If rejected: Follow-up ke customer

**Receipt:**
- Print check detail untuk record

items.title: 6. LAINNYA (Custom Methods)
items.body:
Payment methods custom sesuai business needs.

**Examples:**
- Loyalty points/program
- Voucher/gift card
- Corporate account/credit
- Employee discount
- Store credit

**Proses:**
1. Similar ke method lain
2. Input method-specific fields
3. System validate (verify code, balance, eligibility)
4. Deduct dari balance
5. Record transaction
6. Generate receipt

**Configuration:**
- Admin configure custom methods
- Set validation rules
- Set integration points

content.body:
**PPN (Pajak Pertambahan Nilai) - Sales Tax:**
- Standard rate: 11% (dapat berubah per government regulation)
- Configurable per outlet
- Applied pada: Subtotal - Discount (jika applicable)
- Example:
  * Subtotal: Rp 100.000
  * Discount: Rp 10.000
  * Taxable amount: Rp 90.000
  * PPN 11%: Rp 9.900
  * Total: Rp 99.900

**PPh (Pajak Penghasilan) - Income Tax:**
- Applicable untuk certain categories (opsional)
- Configurable by item/category
- Usually deducted dari amount (tidak add ke total)

**No Tax Products:**
- Beberapa produk exempt (e.g., makanan essential)
- Configuration di master data
- Tidak dikenakan PPN

**Tax Display di Receipt:**
- Subtotal: Rp 100.000
- Discount: -Rp 10.000
- Subtotal setelah discount: Rp 90.000
- PPN (11%): +Rp 9.900
- TOTAL: Rp 99.900

**Tax Reporting:**
- All taxes tracked untuk tax compliance
- Daily/monthly tax summary report
- Integration dengan finance module

items.title: Receipt Format
items.body:
**Header:**
- Outlet/Store name
- Address & location
- Phone number
- NPWP (Tax ID)

**Transaction Info:**
- Receipt number (unique)
- Date & time
- Cashier name
- Order number
- Table # (jika F&B)

**Itemized List:**
- Product name | Qty | Unit price | Line total
- One line per item
- All items detail

**Summary:**
- Subtotal
- Discount (if any)
- Tax (PPN, PPh, etc)
- Total

**Payment:**
- Payment method(s)
- Amount paid
- Change (jika cash)
- Reference # (jika card/QRIS)

**Footer:**
- Thank you message
- Company tagline
- QR code (untuk loyalty/feedback)
- Receipt ID (untuk digital receipt)
- Timestamp

**Receipt Copy:**
- Merchant copy: Untuk toko records
- Customer copy: Untuk customer (untuk return)
- Both printed atau select as needed

items.title: Printing Options
items.body:
**1. Auto Print:**
- Default: Print automatic setelah payment confirmed
- Printer: Thermal 80mm atau 58mm
- Auto feed & cut
- Settings: Configure di POS admin

**2. Manual Print:**
- Operator click 'Print Receipt'
- Print ke selected printer
- Use case: Reprint lost receipt, customer request

**3. Email Receipt:**
- If customer provide email
- System send receipt via email (PDF attached)
- Auto-send after payment
- Or manual resend dari order history

**4. SMS Receipt:**
- If customer provide phone number
- Send short summary via SMS
- Format: Concise (order no, total, method, outlet)
- Cheaper & faster than email

**5. Digital Display:**
- Show receipt di screen
- Customer can screenshot
- Or take photo

**Printer Management:**
- Setup: Admin configure printer port
- Test: Admin can test print
- Offline detection: If printer down → show warning
- Queue: If printer busy → queue transaksi

items.title: Void Order Refund (Full)
items.body:
Saat order di-void sebelum completion, payment harus di-refund.

**Automatic Refund Trigger:**
1. Order status PAID → VOIDED
2. System trigger refund process
3. Refund method sama dengan original payment

**Refund Proses (by method):**

**A. CASH Void:**
- Original payment: Cash Rp 63.000
- Refund: Return cash Rp 63.000 ke customer
- Cashier: Ambil uang dari drawer, berikan ke customer
- Record: Refund amount, refund time, reason

**B. CARD Void:**
- Original payment: Card Rp 63.000
- Refund: Auto-reverse transaksi di EDC/bank
- Timeline: 1-5 business days (tergantung bank)
- No immediate cash refund (batasan kartu)
- Record: Refund reference # (dari bank)

**C. QRIS Void:**
- Original payment: QRIS Rp 63.000
- Refund: Auto-reverse di payment provider
- Timeline: Usually instant (fintech) atau same-day (bank)
- Amount return ke customer's account
- Record: Refund reference #

**D. Multi-Payment Void:**
- Original: Cash Rp 50.000 + QRIS Rp 13.000
- Refund proportional:
  * Cash Rp 50.000 → return cash
  * QRIS Rp 13.000 → auto-reverse
- Or customer choose: Return semua ke 1 method (QRIS saja, dll)

**E. Check Void:**
- Original: Check Rp 63.000
- Refund: No refund (cek not cashed yet)
- Or negotiate: Customer issue new check

**Refund Receipt:**
- Generate refund receipt (negative amount)
- Show: Original order #, refund amount, method, reason
- Timestamp & approval

**Refund Record:**
- Linked ke original order
- Audit trail complete
- For compliance & dispute resolution

items.title: Return Item Refund (Partial)
items.body:
Saat customer return beberapa item (tidak semua order).

**Initiating Return:**
1. Open completed order
2. Click 'Return Items'
3. Select items to return (checkbox)
4. Input quantity per item
5. Calculate partial refund
6. Manager approval (jika > threshold)

**Refund Calculation (Partial):**
- Original order: 3 items total Rp 63.000
- Customer return: 1 item = Rp 20.000 (out of Rp 63.000)
- Refund calculation:
  * Item price: Rp 20.000
  * Proportional discount: Rp 20.000 / Rp 70.000 (before discount) × Rp 10.000 = Rp 2.857
  * Proportional tax: Rp 20.000 / Rp 70.000 × Rp 7.000 (tax) = Rp 2.000
  * Total refund: Rp 20.000 - Rp 2.857 + Rp 2.000 = Rp 19.143 (aprox)
  * Simplified: Rp 20.000 (exact item price)

**Refund by Method:**
- Same as void order
- But partial amount
- Record: Item returned, reason, quantity

**Return Receipt:**
- Show: Original order #, returned items, refund amount
- Negative amount
- Authorization info

**Return Processing:**
- Item discard atau return ke supplier
- Inventory: Stock reversal
- Finance: Refund accounted

content.body:
**Amount Validation:**
- Total tidak bisa 0 (order must have items)
- Total harus > 0
- Amount received harus >= total (untuk cash)
- Multi-payment total harus = order total

**Payment Method Validation:**
- Check method enabled untuk outlet ini
- Verify configuration active
- Check payment gateway status (online/offline)

**Security Measures:**
- Secure payment gateway (SSL/TLS)
- PCI DSS compliance untuk card payment
- Token-based untuk QRIS/digital wallet
- No storage raw card data (PAS handled by EDC/provider)
- Timeout untuk payment request (prevent hanging)
- Limit retry attempt (prevent brute force, fraud)
- Manager approval untuk large transactions
- Audit log semua payment events

**Payment Reconciliation:**
- Daily payment reconciliation dgn bank/provider
- Verify received amount match recorded
- Investigate discrepancy
- Report variance

items.title: Q: EDC not responding during card payment
items.body:
A: EDC machine tidak terkoneksi atau offline.

Check:
1. EDC power on?
2. Connection to device (USB/Bluetooth) active?
3. Payment gateway network available?

Solusi:
1. Check physical connection
2. Restart EDC
3. Switch payment method (cash/QRIS)
4. Contact IT support jika persistently offline

items.title: Q: QRIS payment timeout - customer already paid but system not confirmed
items.body:
A: Customer sudah scan & pay QRIS, tapi system belum terima konfirmasi.

Solusi:
1. Wait 30 sec lebih (payment provider proses)
2. Manually verify: Check payment provider dashboard
3. If confirmed: Manually mark payment received (admin action)
4. If not confirmed: Ask customer retry
5. If issue persist: Contact payment provider support

items.title: Q: Change calculation wrong for cash payment
items.body:
A: Sistem hitung kembalian tidak sesuai.

Check:
1. Verify amount received (customer berikan berapa?)
2. Verify order total (tepat?)
3. Verify tax calculation (benar?)

Solusi:
1. Manual override: Recalculate & input correct change
2. Report ke admin (jika system error)
3. Log ticket untuk investigation

items.title: Q: Cannot refund paid order - EDC/QRIS provider error
items.body:
A: Reverse payment gagal di provider.

Solusi:
1. Retry refund (sometimes transient error)
2. If failed: Manual refund (cashier return cash)
3. Record: Reason, EDC reference, manual action taken
4. Contact payment provider (trace transaksi)
5. Reconcile nanti saat provider reply
